name: arccosh_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::arccosh_(Tensor(a!) self) -> Tensor(a!). Computes inverse hyperbolic cosine in place, mutates self, and returns the same Tensor object and storage. Tests cover deterministic valid-domain floating inputs, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, the boundary at one, infinity and NaN, native invalid-domain NaN behavior, output metadata, mutation, and identity.
